prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **All Star Karate** at **235 Jungermann Road, Suite 101**. It offers children’s karate classes, including programs for younger kids, and advertises a trial period so you can see how your child likes it before committing. Call **(636) 279-3730** to confirm current ages, schedule, and trial details. [All Star Karate](https://allstarkarate.com/kids-martial-arts)

A couple of other options, depending on what your child is interested in:

- **World Martial Arts Academy** — Taekwondo for children ages 4 and up; **1057 Cave Springs Blvd**, **(636) 928-0001**. [School website](https://worldmartialartsacademy.perfectmind.com/)
- **Onyx Grappling** — Kids’ Brazilian jiu-jitsu; **953 Jungermann Road**, **(636) 339-4277**. [Kids’ program](https://onyxgrappling.com/programs/)

I’d visit a class or take a trial lesson and compare how the instructors interact with kids, class size, and total costs before enrolling.
